governing_contract_change: No contract change. Additive implementation of Plan v1.4 §11; immutable accepted migrations and governing PDFs unchanged.

evidence_events: hinted independence; insert guard validates server-observed hint
activity_attempts: scope guard for expired/cancelled/out-of-order Review and superseded runs

identity: No UUID/stable_code/version_code contract change. Review pins existing publication/content/activity UUIDs and does not manufacture published versions.
transaction: Profile lock precedes run/attempt locks. Attempt + evidence + projection + mistake + review settlement + outbox commit/rollback together. Immutable receipts serve retries before terminal-state rejection.
reset: Audited scope and target cutoff mask historic evidence for projection recomputation. Historical records are retained. Current/future progress views must respect these reset jobs rather than treating every historical completed run as current progress.
rollback: Do not edit/drop historical attempts/evidence/publications. Stop new P4 writes and deploy a compatible application rollback; preserve additive tables and return to previous active content pointer through reviewed activation. Any destructive data rollback requires a separate reviewed migration/restore decision.
api_boundary: Authenticated owner/profile; CSRF for writes; allowlisted server proxy; strict request schemas; no endpoint accepts client score, due date, model, owner or AI feedback as authority.
